title: Fix Diagram Piece Drag In Design App
description: Fix piece dragging in Design diagram - node does not move on drag (nodeMovedInViewport=false, du=0, dv=0). Also clean up remaining test diagnostics and get full Design test passing.
summary: Fixed piece dragging by closing left side panel overlay. Fixed Radix slider interaction with XPath ancestor locator for dblclick edit mode. Fixed rotation eval bug. All Design E2E tests pass.
